gav_effect: No direct GAV effect is claimed as the basis for the patch. The change only prevents portfolio-total and balance-sheet labels from remaining in the source-only blocker pool.

html_citations.reason: The coordinate for Liabilities in Excess of Other Assets is a balance-sheet style total line with dollar amount and percentage cells, not an issuer or tranche row.
The coordinate for Net Assets is a standalone net-assets line, confirming this source-only label is not a position-level holding.

patch_summary: Classify Kennedy Lewis-style portfolio and net-asset labels as non-position total/header rows: Investments Portfolio, Investments-Non-Controlled/Non-Affiliated, Liabilities in Excess of Other Assets, and Net Assets.
primary_justification: The four blocker rows are not production positions. Their XBRL labels are portfolio-total or balance-sheet labels, and the HTML coordinates for Liabilities in Excess of Other Assets and Net Assets confirm non-position total-line semantics. The bounded patch adds exact total/header recognition for these labels with regression tests and false-positive coverage.
residual_risk: Residual risk is limited to exact aggregate labels and tested total/header variants. The change does not broaden parsing of issuer/tranche rows and retains false-positive coverage for issuer-bearing source-only rows.
reviewer_notes: Manual review found this is not insufficient evidence. The evidence supports a bounded aggregate/header classification; the existing source-reconciliation patch covers the exact labels in this packet.
source_reconciliation_effect: Expected effect is to move these four source-only rows out of the blocking pool as aggregate/header residuals while preserving real position rows.
tests_validation_plan: Covered by targeted source reconciliation tests in tests/test_validate_holdings.py; validate this verdict with python scripts/bdc_cik_review/validate_verdicts.py --output-dir data/output/bdc_cik_review --all.
